# Médéric Hurier — Fmind

> AI Architect (PhD) • VC Expert Advisor • AAIF Ambassador • GCP Certified Cloud Architect • AI Agents, MLOps & Security

Médéric Hurier designs and industrializes production-grade agentic and MLOps systems, combining enterprise architecture, academic security research, open-source engineering, venture advisory, and community leadership.

## Selected contributions

- [AI Agent Platform guide](https://fmind.medium.com/architecting-the-ai-agent-platform-a-definitive-guide-405750a3de44): Reference architecture for production agent platforms.
- [Agent Levers](https://fmind.medium.com/agent-levers-a-plan-do-check-act-loop-that-makes-coding-agents-finish-what-they-start-8885e4618f38): A Plan-Do-Check-Act operating loop for coding agents.
- [AI Agents as an Operating System](https://fmind.medium.com/ai-agents-as-an-operating-system-rediscovering-the-linux-philosophy-f0e76f29ebdb): A pragmatic, composable architecture grounded in the Linux philosophy.
- [MLOps Coding Course](https://mlops-coding-course.fmind.dev/): Open course connecting software-engineering discipline with production MLOps.
- [mlops-python-package](https://github.com/fmind/mlops-python-package): Production-oriented Python package foundation for MLOps initiatives.
- [PhD thesis](https://orbilu.uni.lu/handle/10993/39903): Research on reliable ground truth and large-scale Android malware characterization with the University of Luxembourg and Google.
